items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: I went out two years with him... He'd take a band out... I worked with Jelly

ctx.x: Somebody once told me you worked with the Jelly Roll on the road.

Oh, yeah, I worked with Jelly. About, well, I went out two years with him. That's how I worked. See, Jelly, he would, in the wintertime, he'd take a band out. He'd go all over. Well, summer, he'd keep band together, but he wouldn't do much playing in the summer. But, I went out two years with him like that, the same way I did with Walter Barnes. He'd go out for the winter all down Florida and everywhere. But, when he'd come back, he had a big grocery in Chicago. Barnes, huh?
Barnes, Walter Barnes? Yeah, Walter Barnes.

items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: Well, I didn't work with him but one year... And that was one of Jelly boozing him in, you know. And the other deal was blown in Chicago, playing different spots all around like that.

ctx.x: And when you worked with Jelly Roll, would you work all year round?

Well, I didn't work with him but one year. Jelly got down sick or something, and the next year, I don't know, even Bain had this winter part, you know. And Swayze, he taken sick and died. And that was one of Jelly boozing him in, you know. And the other deal was blown in Chicago, playing different spots all around like that. So that's how I let this happen. Jelly just passed out like that, and he died pretty soon. I believe he died in New York though. Didn't die in Chicago, died in New York. But now to tell the…
But when you worked with Jelly, was that after you went with Tiny Palm or before?
